Theses queries are executed

```
SELECT Contentbuilders.id AS `Contentbuilders__id`, Contentbuilders.type AS `Contentbuilders__type`, Contentbuilders.parent_id AS `Contentbuilders__parent_id`, Contentbuilders.lft AS `Contentbuilders__lft`, Contentbuilders.rght AS `Contentbuilders__rght` FROM contentbuilders Contentbuilders

SELECT I18n.id AS `I18n__id`, I18n.locale AS `I18n__locale`, I18n.model AS `I18n__model`, I18n.foreign_key AS `I18n__foreign_key`, I18n.field AS `I18n__field`, I18n.content AS `I18n__content` FROM i18n I18n INNER JOIN (SELECT (Contentbuilders.id) FROM contentbuilders Contentbuilders GROUP BY Contentbuilders.id ) Contentbuilders ON I18n.foreign_key = (Contentbuilders.id) WHERE I18n.model = 'Contentbuilders'
```

For example i have my name traductions when the foreign_key = 2 or 3, but not when is 1, and that's what bothers me because I do not know why this happens and if it can reproduce on other foreign_key.
I'm just telling you what is officially supported. I never intended to make it work without the columns in the main table, so I have no idea if that has undesirable side effects.
